convert_instructblip_checkpoint: convert an InstructBLIP checkpoint from the original Salesforce LAVIS repository to a HuggingFace PyTorch model
create_rename_keys: create a list of key rename mappings from Salesforce LAVIS state dict keys to HuggingFace InstructBLIP state dict keys
get_blip2_config: build an InstructBlipConfig with vision, text, and QFormer configs for a given model name
read_in_q_v_bias: read separate q and v biases from the original state dict and concatenate them into a single qkv bias tensor
run_conversion_cli: run the conversion script via argparse CLI to convert an InstructBLIP model and optionally push to the HuggingFace hub
